pr_title: Object: Remove error on disconnect of locked signals
pr_body:
According to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/22637beb2ed625c3e43ab75ab5865b57d7470948#commitcomment-36651823
and as confirmed by @reduz, this seems not to be necessary now that we
copy-on-write.

This triggered freeze scenarios in cases where a node would be deleted
while being used as a target in a signal emission.

Fixes #34650.
Fixes #34769.

Now those two errors go back to reporting:
```
ERROR: emit_signal: Condition ' !target ' is true. Continuing..:
   At: core/object.cpp:1191.
```

CC @timothyqiu
pr_comments:
The second commit also solves the errors printed:
```
ERROR: emit_signal: Condition ' !target ' is true. Continuing..:
   At: core/object.cpp:1191.
```

I kept it separate as it's not necessary for the fix, and the errors pre-existed commit 22637be.
This seems to cause a regression for #33290 (bringing back the read after free) , since ~#33788~ @reduz fix no longer applies.

issue_context.title: Reparenting a node with NodePath by drag and drop causes endless loop
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2 beta

**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10

**Issue description:**
Reparenting a child node by dragging and dropping onto a parent node causes an endless loop if the child node has an assigned NodePath property.

From the Command Prompt:
```
ERROR: Attempt to disconnect [SceneTree:1163] signal 'node_removed' while in emission callback '_node_removed' (in target [Object:22280]). Use CONNECT_DEFERRED (to be able to safely disconnect) or CONNECT_ONESHOT (for automatic disconnection) as connection flags.
   At: core/object.cpp:1522
ERROR: Attempt to disconnect [SceneTree:1163] signal 'node_removed' while in emission callback '_node_removed' (in target [Object:22280]). Use CONNECT_DEFERRED (to be able to safely disconnect) or CONNECT_ONESHOT (for automatic disconnection) as connection flags.
   At: core/object.cpp:1522
ERROR: Attempt to disconnect [SceneTree:1163] signal 'node_removed' while in emission callback '_node_removed' (in target [Object:22280]). Use CONNECT_DEFERRED (to be able to safely disconnect) or CONNECT_ONESHOT (for automatic disconnection) as connection flags.
   At: core/object.cpp:1522
```

Doing the same in 3.1.2 does not cause endless loop:
```
ERROR: emit_signal: Condition ' !target ' is true. Continuing..:
   At: core/object.cpp:1199
```

The issue is not reproducable in 3.0.6.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1) Create a node called "Player" with the following code and save it as a scene:
```
extends Node2D
export(NodePath) var root_node: NodePath = NodePath("..")
```
2) Create another node called "World" and add the "Player" to it as a child.
3) Change "Root Node" property to "World".
4) Dragging "Player" onto "World" cases endless loop.

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[NodePathDragDropCrash.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4049402/NodePathDragDropCrash.zip)
comments: I've had this happen to me too using the focus neighbor properties on control nodes
